title: Construction and application of edge deep learning simulator based on discrete events

pse.problem: Existing network simulation frameworks cannot support distributed learning on edge devices, especially for discrete event simulations, and do not guarantee the effectiveness of edge learning performance verification.
pse.solution_function: The invention constructs an edge deep learning simulator based on discrete events that integrates a deep learning module into the edge simulation environment, enabling distributed learning in the edge environment by caching data at edge nodes and using the deep learning module for deep learning within the simulated edge learning.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of an in-network cache module for data caching at edge nodes, a deep learning module embedded in the simulation module, and an edge simulation environment that supports deep learning.
pse.solution_implementation: The steps include constructing an in-network cache module within the simulation module (step 1), building a deep learning module within the simulation module (step 2.1), creating conditions for joint compilation of the deep learning module and simulation module (step 2.2), and using the deep learning module for deep learning within the simulated edge learning (step 2.3).
pse.effect: The solution improves the effectiveness of edge learning performance verification by supporting discrete event simulations and distributed learning on edge devices.
